# test_gcd.py
# Replace "your_module" with the name of the module containing gcd.
import math

import pytest

from your_module import gcd


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b", "expected"),
    [
        (54, 24, 6),
        (24, 54, 6),
        (17, 13, 1),
        (42, 56, 14),
        (7, 7, 7),
        (1, 999, 1),
        (2**40, 2**32, 2**32),
    ],
)
def test_gcd_positive_integers(a, b, expected):
    assert gcd(a, b) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b", "expected"),
    [
        (0, 0, 0),
        (0, 5, 5),
        (5, 0, 5),
        (0, -5, 5),
        (-5, 0, 5),
        (-54, 24, 6),
        (54, -24, 6),
        (-54, -24, 6),
    ],
)
def test_gcd_zero_and_negative_inputs(a, b, expected):
    assert gcd(a, b) == expected


def test_gcd_matches_standard_library_for_representative_range():
    for a in range(-25, 26):
        for b in range(-25, 26):
            assert gcd(a, b) == math.gcd(a, b)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b"),
    [
        pytest.param("12", 8, id="string-left"),
        pytest.param(8, "12", id="string-right"),
        pytest.param(None, 8, id="none-left"),
        pytest.param([12], 8, id="list-left"),
        pytest.param(8, [12], id="list-right"),
        pytest.param(object(), 0, id="invalid-left-abs"),
    ],
)
def test_gcd_raises_type_error_for_unsupported_inputs(a, b):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        gcd(a, b)
